svg.text: DECODER RING
The napkin ring is the key. A lemon card of swoops looks like abstract calligraphy until a mirror ring stands on it.
THE CARD ALONE
what arrives at the seat: swoops
RING STANDING ON IT, SEEN FROM THE SEAT
ray-traced: name resolves in the mirror
SAME RING FROM THE NEXT SEAT
tilts and slides away: a seat-specific trick
SIDE SECTION, guest at the left (true geometry, mm)
eye 430 up, 450 away
mirror ring
card (lemon, printed)
Reflect the eye ray off the cylinder: where it lands on the card
is where that letter of the name must be printed.
Bottom of the ring (red) lands 34 mm in front of it, the top
(blue) 72 mm, so letters fan out into arcs.
1500 x 500 rays computed; ring r 26, h 50.
THE RING, FLAT (mirror board, 2 x 12 tab, 50 high)
mirror side out; lemon inside
Guest rolls the napkin through the ring,
sets it on the card: name appears in the metal.
Card 160 x 130 mm, rounded.
Name: 5.7 mm cap height in the mirror.
